## Goal
Keep main repo test discovery independent of external official preset details.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `tests/run.js` default and scope discovery do not include bundled official preset directories.
- Main contract fixtures use generic preset names.
- Detailed non-base official preset tests are not required by main repo test runner.

## Implementation Notes
Focus on `tests/run.js`, `tests/helpers/test-runner-search-dirs.js`, and preset-specific tests that import actual official preset modules.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local/static tests for R7/R8 plus updated shared runner helper tests.
